class.name: HTMLDocumentNode
class.brief_description: The root node of a live HTMLLayout document.
class.description: Queries and edits the live DOM of one layout. It becomes invalid when that layout clears or replaces its document. Queries and creation methods on an invalid document node return [code]null[/code] or empty arrays.

method.name: create_document_fragment
method.description: Creates an empty document fragment owned by this document.

method.name: create_element
method.description: Creates a detached element owned by this document.

method.name: create_text_node
method.description: Creates a detached text node owned by this document.

method.name: get_base_uri
method.description: Returns the current base URL of this document.

method.name: get_element_by_id
method.description: Returns the first element with the given case-sensitive ID, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first element in document order that matches [param selector], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns a snapshot of all matching elements in document order.

members.member: The document's body or frameset element, if present.
